chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Ramataim gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Epraim jup tɨɨt gu Elkana gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Eliuu gu mar gu Tou gu mar gu Sup gu Eprateo.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Anna gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Peninna; mi' dhɨr gu Peninna ga'ra' gu ma'nkam gu' gu Anna cham ga'ra'.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' kiicham jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Silo pai' mi'p gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu tanoolh gu Elkana gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia' gu Peninna gu u'vɨ bɨx gu ma'nkam bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ maa'n baasɨ'n.
Gu' gu' gu Anna jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu bhóogɨt; na gu' dha'da' gu Anna gu ux gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix kup gu takarui'.
Na gu' jugi jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix kup gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' oi'ñga'; na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook cham jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Elkana gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu Anna gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook cham jugi gu ux gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' jix duñia' tu' tutkɨ mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Anna mi' dhɨr ka't jugi gu takarui' gu Silo; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eli ka't daakat gu jodai' ju'ñdharan gu takarui' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tasi' bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu takarui' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu chin.
Gu' gu' gu Anna ua'rgidhimɨk gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Eli gu ux gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk dhi' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu Anna jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan gu chuukug; gu' tu' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu jodai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; jano' ba' cham gu takarui' suudai' u'va tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ux gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eli; gio ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui; mi' dhɨr ka't gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt jix jugi cham juruuñ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh o'lhia vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios suulh tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Ramata; gio ba' gu Elkana jix duñia' gu Anna gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan Dios tɨ'ñcho.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Anna jix duñia' gu mar jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Samueel bham; na gu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu chio'ñ gu Elkana bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu tasi'.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Anna cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui'; na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' gu Elkana gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ jix duu gu mar bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ka't gu takarui' jix duñia' baidhak bɨɨx vaik ali' vaakax gu Epa gu tasi' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va jix bhɨɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' tuur aichdhak gu ñi'ook gu Eli.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu chuukug jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ juruuñ ju'ñdharan tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gio gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu tanoolh gu tai ka't gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Anna jix duñia'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix suudai' duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu chin jix duñia' bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ na gu' gu bhóogɨt tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix bhaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mai' tu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu kutun na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n a'gi'ñchu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chin; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx maachim gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu ux gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' kɨɨv gu ñi'ook ga'ra' mui'x gu ma'nkam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' jix maa gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ux jix dhaav tukga'n gu ux jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix búup oo' gampai' gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx chiñia'; gio ba' gu ux gu ja'tkam gu ux gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook nɨidhat; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jix duñia' bhaan oipichu'.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham tɨɨt jɨɨgi'ñdham gu' jix bhai'x gu jodai' gu tukgam; na gu' soo'mchulhdhak ka't jix kavɨk gu ux gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jix duñia' dɨr gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' maa'n gu maa'nkar gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana jix duñia' gu vaak gu Ramata; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eli.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Eli jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ko'kmarak machia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu ja'tkam ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu jodai' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug ka't gu takarui' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu i'ii'ñ vaik gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chuukug gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' duñia' bɨx gu Israelita gu jodai' gu Silo.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' va'k gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chɨtda gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix maa gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n na ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook jano' gu chuukug; jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't uañi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Samueel gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tɨi'chu' gu suudai' gu ux.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu naan kutun na jix toja gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook oidha' tas na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eli jix bhai' aa' gu Elkana gu u'vɨ bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu kai' dhi' gu u'vɨ pai' dhi' gu i'ii'ñ jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr suulh gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Anna jix duñia' vaik gu ma'nkam gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu vaak gu Samueel gɨ'lhidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Eli cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' jix kai bɨx gu ma'nkam duñia' bɨx gu Israeel na ja'p jix koox bɨɨx gu u'vɨ jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu'x tuutu'm na gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam tomaat gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' cham gu ma'nkam gu suudai'; na gu' cham jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ bhaan gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; na gu' gu' tu' oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix duñia' gu ux gu' cham gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu taat na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kooda'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Samueel gu chuukug gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk cham gu suudai' tu' gu duukam gu vaak gu taat na pai' dhuuk mi'p gu Ejipto gu vaak gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' gu takarui' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' tu' gu vaak gu taat bɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' nɨidhat gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chuukug gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' ka't tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat jiim vupui bhaan tu' jix bhai'x; gu' jano' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n na gu' tu' nɨidhat gu ja'tkam gu jodai' ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat cham ka't jix bhai'x gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jugi vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx tu'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu vaak.

Jano' ba' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu chio'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vupui gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu vaak; gu' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak koi gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu ux nɨi'ñchudat dhi' gu takarui' gook gu ma'nkam gu Opni gu Pinees; gio ba' gu ñi'ook koi gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n jurtu'nka' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook jiim vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu vaak ɨlhdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tuumiñ jix toja jodai gu chin gu takarui' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu kutun gu takarui' na ba' jugi gu chin gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Samueel gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Eli; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tanoolh kua' gu Eli jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk gu vupui kua'da' jix duñia' cham gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel ka't kookos vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios pai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't; gio ba' va'k gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jum duu tanaarada'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu Samueel; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Eli; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu oi'ñga'n mɨmɨim gu Eli jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' cham tɨɨgim; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tɨɨt jix duñia' gu Samueel; gio ba' kɨkbo gu Samueel suudai' u'va gu Eli jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨgim jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chuukug tu' cham tɨɨgim; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel cham ka't gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Samueel; gio ba' kɨkbo suudai' u'va gu Eli jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨgim jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Eli gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨt gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' jup tɨɨt daipu'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam gu takarui'; gio ba' ka't gu Samueel jix duñia' pai'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt na ja'p mui'kim; gio ba' gu Samueel jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook maatɨt.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Eli bɨx tu'x tu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak; gio ba' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gio.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ux gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar; na gu' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu jodai' cham tu' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Eli gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Eli cham ka't gu chuukug mɨɨjidha' tu' bɨɨx makgɨrxi'ñdha' tu' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel juruuñ jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh jix kupi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Samueel gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Eli.
Ba' jix aa' tɨɨt gu Eli gu Samueel; gio ba' gu mar gu chuukug gu Samueel; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx tu ñi'ook bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix duñia' bɨx cham gu jodai' cham tu'; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx cham mi'x dhaas gu chuukug gu oidha' matgɨm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu Samueel ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu Silo; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Samueel gu Silo bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ux mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix buus gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu Pilisteos jix duñia' yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu Eben-eser gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu kutun gu Apek.

Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ux yooxi' na ja'p maakobh jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ja'tkam vaak ja'tkam daraa gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos gu takarui' no'ch gu Silo kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bai'ñpu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu suudai' gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n obhɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu ja'tkam gu Silo aichdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; gio ba' gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees mi'p bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va yooxi' bɨx gu Israeel jix maa gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oidha' jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Pilisteos gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' dhi' yooxi' gu ebreos jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap yooxi'.
Na gu' gu Pilisteos chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ na gu' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' tu' tɨbiap gu Jawatan Dios yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gui'p; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'ch va'k jano' cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'ch chɨkka jix duñia' gu noobh dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Ejipto bɨɨx bɨx gu ux oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ na gu' cham gu suudai' gu ebreos na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Pilisteos gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook jiboi'ññor vaak zel; gio ba' ka't gu kutun gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' jix koi ia'rɨ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin suudai' u'va mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Silo gu takarui' jajannulhi'ñ gu oidha' bhaan mo'o.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Eli ka't daakat gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu chuukug gu ux kuiñcha kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ kiicham gɨ' vaak ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx kiicham jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Eli jix kai gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ux mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va jix duñia' jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Eli.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu Eli gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu takarui' gu vupui gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt cham gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Eli; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook jugi; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu mar gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda'; gio ba' gu Israeel jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos gio ka't gu kutun jix koi gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gio gook gu ma'nkam gu Opni gu Pinees koko'kam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob jix duñia' gu suudai' jix koi; na gu' ka't gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't gu chuukug gu Israeel oo'm gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu u'vɨ gu Pinees ka't gu ja'tkam mia'n gu bhóogɨt tɨiñ gu takarui' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhɨɨ koko'kam gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu chio'ñ jix duñia'; na gu' gu vaak gu suudai' tu' vaak na jix bhaan gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi am:―Ja'pji mi'p ju'ñdharan; na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu mar; gu' cham jix aa' tu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu Ikâbod bham; na gu' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel gu ux kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhɨɨ na gu' ka't jix koi gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel; na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios aichdhak dɨr gu Eben-eser gu Asdod.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Pilisteos kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vaak gu Dagoon jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu Dagoon.
Jano' ba' buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu Asdod jix búup gu xibh gu suudai' gu Dagoon gu chuukug gu oidha' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dagoon suulh pai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu xibh buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu suudai' gu Dagoon ka't gu vaak gu chuukug gu oidha' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mo'o gu Dagoon gook gu ñi'ook gu noobh mi'p gu takarui' bhaan gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Dagoon gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Dagoon bɨx vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dagoon ba'k cham gu suudai' gu kutun gu Dagoon gu Asdod bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Asdod jix duñia' naaka'n bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Asdod bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu Asdod gui'p; na gu' cham jix duñia' bɨɨx no'ch kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na gu' gu novɨ gu jodai' bhaan no'ch bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dagoon.

Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu oi'ñga'n bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Gat; jano' ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p a'lhiok gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan kiicham bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu jodai'; gio ba' naaka'n gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham dɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mɨjɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon; gio ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Ekroon gu Ekronitas jix maa jiiñak bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ux kooda' tu' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu oi'ñga'n bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos bham; gio ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt pai' cham gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't gu jodai' koi'm bɨx kiicham gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham koi jix duñia' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu ñi'ook kiicham jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' juruuñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Pilisteos kɨɨv masaa'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Pilisteos tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tɨkka; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu suudai' tɨip pai'.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham gu takarui' jix bhai'x; gu' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' ka't dudua'ñdha' jix maati' gu ux gu ñi'ook cham jix ai'chdhix gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' tu ñi'ook; na gu' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jixchamaam gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai jixchamaam gu chuukug jix uam jodai na gu' gu ux bɨx namki' gio chiñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu suudai' gu oidha' jix duñia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu Egipkios gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt cham mi'x dhaas bhaai'n jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam jano' gu duukam jix vɨɨk jix bhɨɨ gook gu jodai' jix duñia' cham ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' maa'n gu jodai' gu duukam xoi'kam gu suudai' ali' vaakax gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu duukam; gio ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Bet-semes tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham duduaka' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ cham naaka'n tu' jix duñia' gu ux.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duu; na gu' dhaagɨk gook gu jodai' jix duñia' tu jiim gu duukam jix duñia' gu vaak ali' vaakax.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu duukam gu takarui' bɨɨx gu chuukug jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Bet-semes jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt jiim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai'; gio ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu bhaan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Bet-semes.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-semes jix duñia' tiriik gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu vupui jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu duukam suudai' u'va yooxi' gu Josuee gu Bet-semita gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't gu jodai; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu u'u gu duukam jix duñia' gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas tɨsaa'ñdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' ka't ju'ñdharan mi'p gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jix dhaas bhaan mii' dhɨr gu jodai; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Bet-semes gu vaak na jix bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ jixchamaam chiñia' gu Pilisteos suulh gu Ekroon gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu Pilisteos gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ux gu Asdod gu ux gu Gasa gu ux gu Askaloon gu ux gu Gat gu ux gu Ekroon.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix uam jodai jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Pilisteos gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jixchamaam chiñia' dɨr jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm taañpu' cham vaak jodai; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai bhaan jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai yooxi' gu Josuee gu Bet-semita bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' jano' ba' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-semes na gu' gu suudai' tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' naaka'n gu ja'tkam mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu vaak gu chichio'ñ; na gu' gu ja'tkam jix dhaas gu chuukug na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Bet-semes; gio ba' chɨkka gu kutun gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan chɨkka jix tɨ'ɨ dɨr no'ch.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n bham; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu oi'ñga'n bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vaak gu Abinadab gu suudai' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix bhaan gu Eleasar gu mar na ba' jix nukadham kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't dɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' mui'x gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bham; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Astarot tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Baales gu Astarot jix duñia' gu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel gu Mispa tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Mispa jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gui'p; gio ba' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Samueel gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p gu bhóogɨt gu Mispa jix tɨ'ɨ chiñia' gu Pilisteos bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok naak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel chooto'n choo'n gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Samueel; gio ba' cham gu suudai' tu ñi'ook gu ux no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix bhɨɨ mar kaneer bii'm maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Samueel gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios jix kai.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' gu Samueel maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Pilisteos jix duñia' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu jodai' bhaan gu Pilisteos jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Mispa bhiadat gu Pilisteos gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu i'ii'ñ gu Bet-kar.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Samueel gu jodai jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Mispa gu Sen jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Eben-eser bham; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm u'ua'tɨdham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook cham tɨɨtɨs gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Pilisteos bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Samueel.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh gu Pilisteos gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu Israelitas dɨr gu Ekroon bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Samueel gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook jix oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu takarui' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Bet-el gu Gilgal gu Mispa gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bɨx dhi' ja'tkam pai'.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu Rama na gu' ka't gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' pai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't dhaibu gu Samueel gu chuukug jix dhaas gu ma'nkam gu ux gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar maa'nkam mar ka't gu Joel gu tɨɨgɨ' gook gu Abia; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu Beer-seba.
Gu' gu' cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu taat va'k jix duñia' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx daraa gu Israeel jum daa'ñ tɨɨtɨs gu Samueel gu Rama.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam cham gu takarui' gu ux gu bhóogɨt; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu takarui' jano' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' na ja'p bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Samueel dhi' gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu Samueel jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx tu' gu suudai'; na gu' cham tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx buimɨi jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xoi'kam gio bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam kavaayo na ba' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu novɨ xoi'kam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' ka't gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oidha' u'va jix bhai' gu kutun maa'n tu duukam.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu kai' oidha' u'va na ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tu duukam jix bhai' biipibop gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix duñia' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gio kakneer ka't tu duukam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh kuiñcha gu gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu tasi' gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Samueel; gio ba' va'k gui'p; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' no'ch duduaka' gio na ja'p bɨx chɨbɨɨp chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu jodai' vupui bhaan no'ch jix duñia' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Samueel bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix duñia' maatɨt gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu takarui' maa'n kiicham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x jup tɨɨt gu Kis gu mar gu Abiel gu mar gu Seor gu mar gu Bekôra gu mar gu Apia gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu Sauul biapma' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jiix daam no'x gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Kis gu taat gu Sauul; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu Kis gu Sauul gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ jano' bɨndak oi'ñdha' gu suudai' bamii' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu oidha' gu Salisa cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oidha' gu Saalim gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ux pai' gu Benjamiin cham jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu oidha' gu Sup gu Sauul jix duñia' ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' jix ai gu takarui'; na gu' gu kutun gu taat tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ux no'ch.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' cham tu'x jai'ch dhi' kiicham gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu'x gu takarui' cham jix duñia' aajim; jano' ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu kutun jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu chuukug jano'; na gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na gu' gu takarui' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook cham tañia' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tañia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu suudai' bakia' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai; na gu' dhi' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu Israeel no'x gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨtda; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' jano' mɨmɨim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix bhai'x ka't tɨɨgim gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia'; gio ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu chuukug; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu kiicham pai' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu takarui' kiicham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu suudai' gui'p; gio ba' dhi' pai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap kiicham gu ja'tkam juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar jix bhai'x.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kapbhai' kiicham jix duñia' va'k jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhai'x jugi; na gu' gu ja'tkam cham jugi bɨɨx ka'm ka't tɨbiap na gu' ka't jix bhai' aa' gu maa'nkar mi' dhɨr jugi koi'cham; na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ jano' na gu' jano' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham; na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Samueel vupui bhaan busaak na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh va'k gu Sauul gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai' naak gu Samueel bham.

Jano' ba' gu xibh dhi' gu tas tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Benjamiin maa'n gu ux gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel u'ua'tɨda' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; na gu' tu' tu jiim gu ja'tkam na gu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel jix ñi' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren gu ux gu chio'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ux aapi' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu chuukug gu Sauul gu Samueel tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt duukat gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ vupui bhaan tu' jix bhai'x jugi gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ux gu xibh tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' vaik gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia' gaagam; gu' gu ux chɨkka bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu ux bɨx gu vaak gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' gu mar gu Benjamiin gu oi'ñga'n jix ali' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ja'tkam vaak cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨx ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu ux gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nɨidhim.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Samueel gu Sauul jix duñia' gu chuukug jix maa pai' gu vaak koi'cham jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu jodai'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ux tu' tu ñi'ook nuuka'n dɨlhkob.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka't bhaan jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Samueel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' ka't gu suudai'; jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan tu' jugi; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu suudai' nukadham na ba' tu' na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' amuub gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu Sauul jix jugi mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok jix duñia' jix bhai'x kiicham bɨɨx gu Sauul gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix duñia'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Samueel jup tɨɨt gu Sauul ka't gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' bamii' na ba' tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' jix búup gu Sauul moor mai' gu ñi'ook gu Samueel.

Ba' jix aa' jix dhaav gu maa'nkar kiicham gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu takarui'; gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk jano' ba' gu Samueel gu oi'ñga'n bɨ'ñdhatu' ja'aa bhaan mo'o gu chuukug; gio ba' cham tu' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu suudai' bhaan gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak tu' bakia' gook gu chichio'ñ ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu Rakêl gu ñi'ook gu Benjamiin gu Selsa tu' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gaagam; mi' dhɨr gu taat tu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu' xoi'kam jix bhai'x gu ux gu ñi'ook bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu mar.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n vaak ja'tkam gu Tabor tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu chichio'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-el gu suudai' maa'n vaik gu bhóogɨt vaik gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' vaik gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n tulhiiñdha' tu' jix duñia' gook gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu noobh.

Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu takarui' gu Pilisteos; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n kiicham gu ñi'ook chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu jodai' jix bhai'x vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka' gu jodai' gu chio'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu oi'ñga'n daam dhi' buimɨk gu vupui tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug vupui bhaan tu' gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chuukug gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duu gu Samueel jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bɨx dhi' buimɨk jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu jodai' jix ai bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu takarui' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk bɨx jix maati' gu ñi'ook va'k jix duñia' na ja'p jix duñia' bɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ja'tkam chɨtda maa'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Kis gu Sauul gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' oi'ñdha'; gio ba' chɨkka gu taat gu ux dhi' kuiñcha jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gio gu Sauul tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ jix duñia' jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Sauul jix duñia'; gio ba' duukat jix bɨɨx duu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug cham gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu Samueel.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gu' gu chuukug oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Samueel ka't tu ñi'ook cham jix ñi'ñ cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.

Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu Ejipto gu takarui' gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia'.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix nukadham bɨx tulhiiñ gu suudai' gui'p; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr jano' jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux bopxi'ñ gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu Samueel bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ka't jix bhɨɨ bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix bhɨɨ ja'tkam vaak gu Matri; gio ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu' cham ka't gaagam.
Jano' ba' tɨkka jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam dɨr gu ñi'ook jiix ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' buupui tu' gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim bɨx gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ua'na u'uan nukadham vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Samueel bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu Sauul gio ka't gu vaak gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't dhaa.
Gu' gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux chooto'n gu jodai' cham aichdhak gu o'o; gu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Naas gu Ammonita jix duñia' yooxi' bhaan gu Jabes gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu Jabes gui'p gu Naas; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx no'ch tu' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu Naas gu Ammonita jix aa'; gio ba' bɨɨx dhi' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa gu Jabes gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh na ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' soo'mchulhdhak ka't gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu chuukug gu Sauul gui'p dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Sauul gu jodai' yooxi' bhaan gu vaakax; gio ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Jabes.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Sauul tɨiñ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tai daak.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu ñi'ook gu vaakax jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhañ gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ux gu novɨ gu takarui' bham; gio ba' no'x cham gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Samueel ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam moor na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Besek; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaik jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu suudai' tɨbiap; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Jabes gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu xibh gu bhóogɨt gu tas jix duñia' dodhia'; jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jabes jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jabes gui'p; gio ba' gu xibh gu ñi'ook bhaan na ba' xoi'kam bɨɨx no'ch bɨx xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul gu ja'tkam vaik gu chuukug baap tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak ja'tkam jix duñia' gu xibh jix duñia' gu Ammonitas bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook gook tɨtda:―Aañ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' chɨkka am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Sauul bhaan no'ch jix maa jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; na gu' cham koi gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Samueel gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu Gilgal na ba' gu chuukug oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Gilgal jix duñia' gu Sauul gu ux gu gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix jai' gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' naak gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' tu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; gu' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook dɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' dhi'; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhɨɨ gu vaakax oi'ñdha' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' tu' gu takarui' jix bhai'x tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñdha' tu' jix bhai'x jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu ux ka't jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu takarui' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' bhaan gu ñi'ook gio gu tasi' dhi' gu tanoolh cham jix duñia' gaagam gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ matgɨm; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix buusñi tattat gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr gu Jakob ka't kia'mi'ñ gu Ejipto tattat tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duñia' tattat gu Ejipto jix duu jix daa dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Siisara gu suudai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Asor gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gui'p; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' jix duñia' gu Baales gu Astarot; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt jano' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Jerobaal gu ñi'ook gu Jeptee gu Samueel jix duñia' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh jix daa gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhaibu buupui gu Naas gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu tasi' jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu ñi'ook na ja'p bhaan tattat.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jano' gu suudai' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' cham jano' oraa' gu ñi'ook tu' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; na ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' jix gɨ' tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Samueel; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ux tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham vaak jodai; na gu' bɨx uañi'ñ gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' cham bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' na ba' no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jix duñia' jugi bɨx dhi' cham bhai'; gu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ux jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n duñia' gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Na ba' gu suudai' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' tu'r bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na gu' jix duñia' gu suudai' tu'x tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug cham bhai' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu Sauul gu gɨ'kora' oi'ñga'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gook gu takarui' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaik jix bhai'x gu Israeel; gio ba' gook jix bhai'x jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Sauul gu Mikmas gu kavɨk gu Bet-el jix bhai'x jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Jonataan gu chuukug gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr bhañ bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gu Jonataan naaka'n gu takarui' gu Pilisteos ka't gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jix duu gu Sauul kuichdha' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu ux bɨx gu oidha' bham; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ebreos.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix kai chɨtda; gio ba' gu Sauul tu' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gio gu Israeel gu chuukug cham bhai' gu Pilisteos; jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu Gilgal.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ na ba' gu ux bɨɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu ux jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu ja'tkam na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' yooxi' gu Mikmas tas buusñi gu Bet-aben.
Na gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't gu ux jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ebreos gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Gad gu Galaad; gio ba' gu Sauul ka't gu ñi'ook gu Gilgal bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chuukug bhaan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Samueel ka't tu ñi'ook; gu' gu Samueel cham gu jodai' gu Gilgal gu ja'tkam jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chuukug maa'nkar tai bhaan gu suudai' gu Samueel gu jodai'; gio ba' gu Sauul jix buus gu takarui' na ba' tulhiiñdha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul jix aa'; na gu' tu' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos mi'p tɨtda:―Aañ gu Mikmas.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix dhaav jano' bhaan tu' gu Gilgal tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu takarui'; na gu' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' gu' jano' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham ka't jix bhai'x; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix ka't gu suudai' bhaan gu ja'tkam na gu' tu' cham nukadham gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Samueel jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gilgal gu chuukug gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Benjamiin; gu' gu Pilisteos jix daa gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Mikmas.
Jano' ba' moor yooxi' gu Pilisteos gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu chuukug; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Opra bhaan gu oidha' gu Sual.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan gu Bet-oron vaik gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan jix suudai' duu tu jiim gu suudai' gu Seboim bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Pilisteos gu suudai' tu ñi'ook; na ba' gu ebreos cham xoi'kam gu kuchii gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix dhaav gu Pilisteos gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu chin gu i'ii'ñ gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm na ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jugi.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu chuukug cham gu ñi'ook gu kuchii tu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ oi'ñdha' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar ko'kmarak.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Pilisteos jix buus gu bhóogɨt gu Mikmas.
Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh ka't gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu Pilisteos mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jix duu maachim gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul ka't gu oidha' gu chuukug bɨtaa'n gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch gu Migroon gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx ka't na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu mar gu jodai' xibhɨk gu Ikâbod gu mar gu Pinees gu mar gu Eli jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' cham bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Jonataan gu takarui' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' gu Jonataan jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Pilisteos ka't gu jodai' na jix uam gu maa'nkar baasɨ'n; gio ba' maa'n jup tɨɨt gu Boses gu Sene.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Mikmas saagi'ñ bhaan gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu kutun jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux no'ch; na cham gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu vaak jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' bɨndak aagak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu suudai' no'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' bhaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' pai' cham jix tɨ'ɨ.
Gu' gu' tu' gu suudai'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ no'ch; na gu' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu noobh; jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ux nɨi'ñchudat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ebreos gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ no'ch chulhiiñchuda' maachim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jonataan jix aa' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jonataan gu suudai' bɨɨx gu noobh tɨɨt bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jonataan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook ɨraab gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' vaak ja'tkam gu ux yooxi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu takarui'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gio gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sauul jix duñia' dɨr gu chuukug gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n ka't jix duñia' gu chuukug baasɨ'n ka't gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' chɨkka ka't gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' a'lhiok gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' gu bhóogɨt a'gi'ñchu' gu Sauul bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' na jix uam ka't yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu chuukug gu takarui'; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Sauul jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Sauul bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm pai' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu suudai' gu kuchii maa'n ka't gu oi'ñga'n bhaan duiñchu' jix koi ka't jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu ebreos gu suudai' dhi' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook va'k gu suudai' tɨbiap bɨɨx xikoolh yooxi' gio suulhgia' suulh na ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu Israelitas mi'p bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu Jonataan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu Israelitas gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam gu kavɨk gu Epraim tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu takarui' gio jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-aben.

Gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' gu Sauul ka't gu takarui' gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu Kualkuiera jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai bɨɨx ka'm ka't jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' obhɨɨ'ñ ka't gu kutun; jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam cham ka't gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ux pai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu vupui yooxi'.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu ja'tkam gu ux gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu takarui' gu novɨ gu chin; na gu' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan cham ka't naak na pai' dhuuk gu taat jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu ñi'ook gu novɨ jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ gu chin; gio ba' gu vupui jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu taat tu' gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu kutun ka't gu chio'ñ jugi gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu taat tu' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' jano' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jugi gu takarui' obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jano' jix gɨ' gu takarui' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos dɨr gu Mikmas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gu' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ kakneer gu jodai' ali' vaakax jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ja'tkam jix jugi bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ aa'ñdham gu Sauul gui'p; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug jano' jix bhai'x jix gɨ' gu jodai.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' a'ga; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ja'tkam ja'xñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n gu ñi'ook kaneer gu chuukug jugi; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ux gu novɨ gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Sauul jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't maa'n pai'x gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu chuukug gu tukaa' bhaan gu Pilisteos gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh cham mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gui'p; jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix aa' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Israeel gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix maa gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu takarui' jix bhai'x bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ux chɨkka tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu Israeel tu' ka't gu mar gu Jonataan koi tɨɨda'; gio ba' cham ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' no'm gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jonataan gu mar dhi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu Sauul; jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu jix bhɨɨ gu Jonataan gu Sauul gu ja'tkam jix buus namkidhat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jonataan gu mar; mi' dhɨr ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Jonataan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook jix aa'; jano' ba' tɨɨda' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu vaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' koi.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' cham jix duñia' koi gu Jonataan.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu ja'tkam gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' koi gu Jonataan tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' tulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' gu Israeel cham ka't; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt mo'o gu oidha' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Jonataan na ba' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul mi'x dhaas gu chuukug gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh; gio ba' bhaan gu Moab bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bhaan gu Edom bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba bhaan gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr pai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham naaka'n gu Amalek jix duñia' gu Israeel gu novɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sauul jix bɨɨx duu gu Jonataan gu Isui gu Melki-sua; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' gu Merab jix ali' gu Mikâl.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't gu Ainoam mar u'vɨ gu Aimaas; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu suudai' gu Sauul.
Na gu' na gu' gu Kis gu taat gu Sauul gu Ner gu taat gu Abner jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Abiel.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't jix kavɨk bhaan gu Pilisteos bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Sauul; gio ba' no'x gu Sauul gu chuukug gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' baidhak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ tu' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug jix duu gu Amalek gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu Amalek gu bhóogɨt bɨx jix duñia'; gio ba' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' kakneer jix ai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Telaim gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x tɨɨt mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Sauul kiicham gu Amalek jix dhaas gu maa'nkar gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amalek na ba' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨma'n bɨɨx; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto; jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul naaka'n gu Amalek dɨr gu abila bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu Sur gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Agag tutkɨ kakneer gu vaakax jix gɨ' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug bɨx jix bhai'; na cham jix duñia' cham tu' duu; gu' bɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel bham.

Na gu' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' cham tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Samueel na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Sauul gu ux gu xibh; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Samueel bham; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul tu' tɨbiap gu Karmel gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Gilgal.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu vaakax gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax dhi' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa'; gio ba' gu Amalek jix duñia' gu jodai'; na gu' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tutkɨ kakneer gu jodai' na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu jodai' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' jix ali' gu vupui cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mo'o bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios tu' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' tu' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' u'ua'tulhdhix gu Amalek tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook cham naak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' va'k naak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu jodai' gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek gu jodai' gu Amalekitas.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' kakneer gu jodai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' juraa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu suudai' bɨɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan gu suudai' na ja'p gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tutkɨ makgɨrxi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p uañi'ñ gu suudai' uañi'ñ na ja'p duiñxim gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gio tu' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; na jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jano' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug na ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' cham gu jodai' bɨndak; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Samueel na ba' jix duu mi'x juu'ñ gu novɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' jix maa tɨtmo tutkɨ tu'.
Jano' ba' gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel cham gu chuukug tu' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' cham gu chio'ñ na ba' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan daraa gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug na ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Samueel bhaan gu Sauul jix duñia' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Samueel; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek; mi' dhɨr gu Agag suudai' u'va jix bhai'x; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Agag; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim koi'm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' na ja'p gu kuchii mi'x dhaas gu u'vɨ cham gu ma'nkam gu naan ka't cham gu mar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Samueel jix duñia' bapaalh gu Agag vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samueel gu Rama gu Sauul jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu chuukug gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr jix ñi' gu Samueel gu Sauul bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Samueel jix duñia' gu Sauul; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' jix xuaak gu Sauul gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Isaii gu Bet-leem; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu' gu Sauul gu bhóogɨt mu'aa; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨndak gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' mɨmɨim gu Isaii gu maa'nkar tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n tu' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu Samueel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Bet-leem daraa kiicham moor gu takarui' bɨɨx ɨɨbhi'ñ gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt namkia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu maa'nkar; jano' ba' jix bhaan gu Isaii gu ma'nkam jup tɨɨt gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p tɨɨtɨs jix ñi' gu Eliab; gio ba' tɨɨda' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Samueel; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' jix gɨ' dhi' na gu' tu' gu vaak; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' cham gu chio'ñ gu suudai'; na gu' gu chio'ñ gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Isaii gu Abinadab jix duu gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' gu ux tu' gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Isaii gu Samma; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ux tu' gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Isaii kɨɨv gu ma'nkam vupui bhaan gu Samueel; gu' gu Samueel jix aa' gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu tasi' suulhgia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Isaii; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix ali' gu ñi'ook kakneer; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Isaii; na gu' gu jodai' gu ux na gu' cham gu ñi'ook meesa bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' bamii' gu bhóogɨt gu ux.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr jix búup gu Samueel jix duñia' gu Rama.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu Sauul jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Sauul gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan tu duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu suudai' oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n kuichdha' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk na ba' na pai' dhuuk ka't bhaan tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' bɨɨx gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu chuukug jano' oi'ñdha' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' maa'n gu suudai' jix aa' bham; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' buupui gu mar gu Isaii gu Bet-leem gu maa'nkar kuichdha' jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ gu takarui' gu Isaii bham; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Dabii gu mar bɨɨx kakneer.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Isaii gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu bhóogɨt bhañ gu Sauul gu ux gu novɨ gu Dabii gu mar.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Dabii gu Sauul juruuñ vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' jix jai' ka't gu ñi'ook kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ a'ga gu Isaii; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu Dabii gu chuukug; na gu' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Sauul gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bɨɨx gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Sauul ga'ra' gu ja'tkam ka't tutkɨ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ chugi'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu Sokô gu Judaa jix duñia' yooxi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sokô gu Aseka gu Epes-dammim.
Jano' ba' gio gu Sauul gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jum daa'ñ jix duñia' yooxi' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu chuukug bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos mi'p bhaan gu kavɨk baasɨ'n gu Israeel ka't bhaan gu kavɨk baasɨ'n gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix buus jano' ba' gu chio'ñ yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak ja'tkam jup tɨɨt gu Goliat gu Gat ga'ra' jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' mo'o gu chuukug tɨi'chu' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai kutun kavɨk gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt ka't na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar ga'ra' jix kavɨk jodai gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' gu chuukug kutun kavɨk vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maa jiiñak gu chuukug gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu chuukug cham jix duñia' tu' gu Pilisteo gu takarui' tu duukam gu Sauul jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu chuukug no'ch duduaka' tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't gu oi'ñga'n tu duukam tu juan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Pilisteo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu chio'ñ gu suudai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteo jix duñia' chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't gu mar mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Eprateo gu Bet-leem gu Judaa gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Isaii ga'ra' gu tasi' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Sauul jix duñia' jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' vaik gu ma'nkam gu duukam gu Isaii gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu Sauul bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' vaik gu ma'nkam gu suudai' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu Eliab maa'nkam mar gook gu Abinadab vaik gu Samma.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jix ali'; gio ba' bhiadat vaik gu duukam gu Sauul.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu Sauul na ba' gu chuukug kakneer gu taat gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' mii' dhɨr gu Pilisteo gu ux gu xibh gu xumai jix duñia' gu ux oo'm gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaii gu Dabii gu mar; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu Epa dhi' kai'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' jootom vaak ja'tkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bii'm gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel mi'p gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux bɨɨx gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii gu xibh jix duñia' kakneer gu ñi'ook jix nukadham ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Isaii ka't jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu chuukug na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' gu Israelitas na ja'p gu Pilisteos mi'p jir bɨx bhai' gu suudai' bhaan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu novɨ nukadham gu jodai' dai'bus gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam tu' mi'p gu i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' kua' a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak ja'tkam jup tɨɨt gu Goliat gu Pilisteo gu Gat jix buus gu chuukug gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix kai gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n ko'kmarak choo'n.

Jano' ba' maa'n gu Israeel chɨtda; gio ba' cham jix duñia' buupui mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx namkɨm maa'n mar u'vɨ jix duñia' gu suudai' gu vaak gu taat gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii ju'ñdharan mi'p bham; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu chio'ñ gu chuukug dhi' gu Pilisteo gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Israeel na gu' chɨkka dhi' gu Pilisteo gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' gu takarui' ñiokda' gu Eliab xibhɨk jix gɨ' bɨɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Eliab gu tai daak bhaan gu Dabii; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x chɨkka tɨtda:―Cha'pim mii' dhɨr gu vaak kakneer oidha' jix gaki tu' kakasnira' gu ux gu maa'nkar gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' dhi' cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu takarui' bhaan; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook na ja'p gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Sauul gu kutun.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha; mi' dhɨr tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨɨx dhi' gu Pilisteo.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' cham gu kutun tu' bhaan mii' dhɨr gu Pilisteo na ba' gu ux bɨɨx; na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham dɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' tu duukam ka't bipia'dam kakneer gu taat gu jodai' maavɨt gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ gu kutun mar kaneer gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' busaak tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chin; gio ba' tu' jix búup bhaan tu' jootos gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jum duu maavɨt jum duu gu chuukug tu duukam jix duñia'; na gu' dhi' gu Pilisteo gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p maa'n na gu' tu' gu takarui' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug maavɨt gu chuukug gio jix duñia' gu novɨ dhi' gu Pilisteo; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n jix dhaas bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na gu' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu kuchii bhaan jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook jiim na gu' cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu tasi'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; na gu' tu' cham gu takarui' jiim bɨɨx dhi' na gu' cham pai' dhuuk gu takarui'; jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu Dabii mii' dhɨr tu'x.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ jix duñia' jixchamaam gu jodai gu vaak gu jodai' jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu takarui' gu novɨ jix duñia' bhaan gu Pilisteo.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteo gu jodai' jiim gu suudai' gu Dabii kutun kavɨk vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteo jix duñia' jix ñi' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu jodai'; na gu' ka't biapma' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Pilisteo gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gagai' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx kaapak gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu ux gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' gu kutun tu' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Pilisteo; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' tu' bɨɨx gu kuchii gu bhóogɨt kutun kavɨk; gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu Israeel tu' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' kapbhai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' mo'o tu'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Pilisteos gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu oidha' bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bɨx dhi' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios cham dodhia' bɨɨx gu kuchii gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham kapbhai' gu novɨ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Pilisteo jix búup na ba' tu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Dabii jix maa gu chuukug dai'bus jugi bhaan gu Pilisteo.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu novɨ gu ux jix bhɨɨ gu jodai jix duñia' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt naaka'n gu Pilisteo gu vaak; gio ba' gu jodai jix duñia' gu vaak jix duñia' gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu Pilisteo bɨɨx gu takarui' gu jodai; gio ba' naaka'n gu Pilisteo jix duñia' cham mambhɨɨx gu Dabii gu kuchii gu novɨ.
Gu' gu' dai'bus gu Dabii jix dhaas bhaan gu Pilisteo dhaagɨk gu kuchii gu chuukug gu ux jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mo'o; gio ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix koi jiboi'ññor.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Israeel gu Judaa jix maa gu bhóogɨt bhiadat gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm kiki'ñgob gu Ekroon; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu chuukug gu Pilisteos gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Saraim bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat gu Ekroon.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chuukug gu Pilisteos jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ mo'o gu Pilisteo jix bhɨɨ gu Jerusalem gu' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak zel.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul jix ñi' gu Dabii busaak jix ai bɨɨx gu Pilisteo gu Abner gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Abner chɨkka gu mar mii' dhɨr biapma' gu Abner jix aa'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham tu'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook chɨkka gu mar mii' dhɨr biapma'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu ñi'ook kooda' gu Pilisteo gu Abner jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Sauul da'p mo'o gu Pilisteo gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' biapma' chɨkka gu chuukug gu mar gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu mar tu duukam gu Isaii gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook ñiokda' bɨɨx gu Sauul gu i'ii'ñ gu Jonataan ka't gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jonataan na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat.
