Na gu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jonataan gu Dabii na gu' dha'da' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan cham kutun gu ñi'ook ga'ra' bhaan jix maa gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu kuchii gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' busaak gu Dabii pai' gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix duu gu ux gu jodai' gu Sauul gu suudai' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu ux gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu suudai' gu Sauul.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii jix duñia' kooda' gu Pilisteo moor gu u'vɨ bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel jix duñia' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu kutun gu suudai' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' alabaa'n gu u'vɨ jix duñia' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Sauul naaka'n gu ja'tkam gu Dabii mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' bhaam gu Sauul jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui; gio ba' gu Dabii jix maa mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam tu' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr cham uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Sauul jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu Sauul jix duñia' gu vaak bɨɨx bhaan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' gu Dabii gu jodai' bɨɨx gu novɨ na ja'p gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sauul jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gook mui'kim jix ai'chdhix gu Dabii.
Na gu' gu' gu Sauul gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx ka't gu vaak gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix ai'chdhix gu Sauul gu suudai' jix bhai'x; gio ba' busaak jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu takarui' jix bhai'x bɨx gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Sauul jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' gu' bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa dha'da' gu Dabii na gu' busaak jix duñia' vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' gu Merab mar u'vɨ jix gɨ' gu ux gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Sauul chɨtda; gio ba' cham ka't gu novɨ bhaan gu' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' ja'tkam vaak gu taat gu Israeel na ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tɨbiap gu ñi'ook gu Merab mar u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't gu chuukug gu Dabii ka't gu jodai' gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Adriel gu Meolatita.
Gu' gu' gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul dha'da' gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu bhóogɨt gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' na ba' ka't gu ux gu vaak na ba' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos ka't bhaan; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; jano' ba' bɨɨx ka' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Sauul gu suudai'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook ɨxchuixim gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' tu' xoi'kam bɨx gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam; jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Sauul tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' tu' gu chio'ñ gampai' matgɨm jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Sauul jix maa gu suudai' bham; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr cham gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos na ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Sauul jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ gu Dabii gu noobh gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii dhi' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu Dabii na ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii ta'tak bɨɨx gu ja'tkam naaka'n gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu ñi'ook kapbhai' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' na ba' jum duu gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Gu' gu' gu Sauul ñɨi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu Dabii mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl dha'da'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu Sauul bhaamki'ñdha' gu Dabii bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix buus chiñia' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' na ja'p jix buus jix duñia' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x bɨx tu duukam gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar bɨx gu suudai' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii; gu' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul dha'da' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Sauul gu taat jix duñia' kooda'; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu suudai' jano' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh tu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' dhi' ju'ñdharan gu taat yooxi' pai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu taat tu' gu bhóogɨt maachim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan xoi'kam gu Dabii gu Sauul gu taat; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu duukam gu Dabii matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jugi bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr va'k buimɨi tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook naaka'n gu Pilisteo gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr gu tasi' gu jodai' gu Dabii cham kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham koi.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu Sauul juruuñ vupui bhaan na ja'p va'k.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buus gu Dabii gu ux bhaan gu Pilisteos naaka'n bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu takarui' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' kua' daakat gu vaak ga'ra' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar; gu' jix ai'chdhix vupui bhaan gu Sauul naaka'n bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ gu takarui' gu vaak gu Dabii na ba' nukadham gu oi'ñga'n gu xibh; gu' gu Mikâl gu u'vɨ jix ñi'ñ gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' dhi' gu tukaa' gu xibh ka' jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Mikâl gu Dabii gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Mikâl dhi' jix dhaas bhaan gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ux gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul bhañ gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jix aa'; gio ba' ka'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sauul tɨip gu takarui' na ba' gu jodai' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu takarui' baap gu suudai' dhi' ka't gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Mikâl; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' gu Mikâl jix aa' gu Sauul; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu takarui' tu'; gio ba' tu' cham tu' kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Samueel gu Rama bɨx gu Sauul ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Samueel jix koi gu Najot.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Dabii gu Najot gu Rama.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Sauul gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jix duñia' chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu Samueel ka't gu tanoolh; gio ba' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu takarui' gu Sauul gio jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't maachim gu Sauul bhañ gu takarui' gio jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' tɨip gu ux gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu takarui' gio jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Rama; gio ba' gu chuukug oidha' suudai' jix gɨ' gu chuukug tɨtda:―¿Jax bham; mi' dhɨr duukat gu Samueel gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Najot gu Rama.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Najot gu Rama; gio ba' gio suudai' u'va bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu Najot gu Rama.

Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Samueel jix duñia' tɨbiaptuda bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Sauul tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Najot gu Rama suudai' u'va vupui bhaan gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ bhaan gu taat gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' matgɨm; mi' dhɨr cham koi; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu taat matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jix gɨ' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu taat dhi' gu chuukug cham ka't.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' ñi'ook kavɨk aa' bham; gio ba' gu taat gu maa'nkar gu duukam tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu chuukug; na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu Jonataan na gu' cham jix duñia' jix duu; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' koi'm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ux tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' gu xibh ka't gu ja'tkam gu masad tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' jugi; gu' tu' kiicha' gu takarui' yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu taat gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' daipu'; na gu' jix duñia' jix jai' mi'x dhaas tu' jootom gu Bet-leem kiicham na gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam namki' gu maa'nkar gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' xoi'kam bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu duukam; gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx tu duukam tu' gu jodai' tu duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak; gio ba' tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr va'k xoi'kam tu' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu taat na ba' jix ai bhaan tu' cham ka't tu' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Jonataan; gio ba' chɨkka maa'n aa'ñdham gu ñi'ook tu' gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii; gio ba' gu kutun gu takarui' yooxi'; mi' dhɨr moor gu ñi'ook yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n tu' tu ñi'ook gu taat gu xibh dhi' gu tas mi' dhɨr gu xibh jix ñi'ñ xoi'kam na ba' bɨɨx gu Dabii tu' jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu suudai'; gu' tu' gu taat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug cham bhai' gio tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu bhóogɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak na ja'p ka't bɨɨx gu taat.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tai jix duu gu chuukug xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios; gu' tu' ka't jix koi.

Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' jix bhai'x xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu vaak; na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu ux maa'n obhɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu oidha' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jonataan ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Jonataan ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu Dabii na gu' dha'da' na gu' dha'da' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; na gu' gu xibh gu ja'tkam gu masad tu' ka' baas gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu Estaraas vaik gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n ɨlhdham pai' dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam gu tanoolh tu jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ju'ñdharan gu jodai gu Esel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu takarui' bhaan mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu takarui' jix toja.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu jiim gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu takarui'; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' ɨlhdham na gu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook cham tu' cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n tu'; na gu' gu chuukug na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' tu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' yooxi' namkia' ka't gu ja'tkam gu masad jix daa gu gɨ'kora' jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix daa gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu maa'nkar gu Jonataan jix búup jix daa gu Abner gu ñi'ook gu Sauul pai' gu Dabii ka't cham tu'x jai'ch.
Ba' jix aa' gu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Sauul cham cham tu' na gu' chɨtda; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook cham na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gook gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam gu masad ka't gio gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu Jonataan gu mar; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham tu' tɨbiap jugi gu mar gu Isaii gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' jix bhai'x mi'x dhaas tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-leem.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' jix duñia' mi'x dhaas tu' na gu' tañia' gu maa'nkar chulhiiñdha' gu ma'nkam kiicham xibhɨk tu' jix aa'ñdhix; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham tu' tɨbiap gu vaak na jix bhai' gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' bhaan gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu mar jix maat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu' gu tasi' gu mar gu Isaii na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu suudai' na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam xi'ɨraam gu naan.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Isaii gu tai bhaan gu oidha' tu' ka' gu ñi'ook tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu jodai' jano' gu oi'ñga'n na gu' tu' koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu taat gu Sauul; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook koi gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' pai' jix duñia' gu Jonataan gu taat ka't gu tanoolh kooda' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jonataan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu chuukug gu ñi'ook cham jix jugi gu takarui' gook gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam gu masad; na gu' ga'ra' gu vaak kuiñcha gu Dabii na gu' gu taat ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu xibh jix buus gu Jonataan yooxi' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bɨɨx gu Dabii gu takarui' jix ali' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' tu jiim gu takarui' tu' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jonataan ka't gu suudai' gu Jonataan jix maa jiiñak bhaan gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jonataan bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu takarui' cham tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan jix duñia' gu takarui' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jonataan gu Dabii gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jix maa gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' kiicham.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam jix búup gu Dabii baasɨ'n saagi'ñ jix duñia' vaik mui'kim gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt maa'n gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨɨx gu ux gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' gu chuukug bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai' gu suudai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; jano' ba' jix búup ka't; gio ba' gu Jonataan chɨbiapui kiicham.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu Nob gu Aimelek jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Aimelek gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu duukam soo'mchulhdhak bɨndak.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu chuukug jix aa'; mi' dhɨr soo'mchulhdhak gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi' gu chuukug tu' jootsa' tu' jix aa'ñdhix; jano' ba' tu' nɨi'ñchudat gu suudai' tɨɨda' pai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt jixchamaam gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Dabii; gio ba' cham no'ñ gu takarui' kua'dam gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' no'ñ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n; gu' gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' jix duñia' nukadham gu maa'nkar gu u'vɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na pai' dhuuk tɨɨda' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu chuukug dɨr gu jodai' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu jɨɨgi'ñdham gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu jodai'.

Na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n na gu' cham ka't gu takarui' tɨkiix gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jaisaidhat gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't maa'n tu duukam gu Sauul gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Doeg gu suudai' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bipia'dam gu Sauul.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Aimelek; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ u'u kavɨk gu kuchii na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu kuchii tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' gu kuchii gu Goliat gu Pilisteo tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr matgɨm na ja'p; jano' ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Sauul suudai' u'va gu Akîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Akîs gui'p; gio ba' cham gu ux gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' cham gu ux alabaa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu Sauul gu ja'tkam gu Dabii mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' choo'n gu Akîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu noobh gu o'o gu jodai' kiki'ñgob mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs tu duukam; gio ba' gu suudai' ñɨi'ñ gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu jodai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' tu jiim na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu ux gu jodai' gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu' ka't jix ai gu ux gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu ñi'ook jumpa'n gu Adullam; gio ba' na ja'p gu chuukug gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu taat tɨɨtɨs.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' baidhak na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Dabii gu Mispa gu Moab gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu taat gu naan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix daa bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Dabii juruuñ gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gad gu Dabii; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu oidha' gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii ta'tak suudai' u'va gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sauul na ja'p ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii mi'p bɨɨx; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Sauul gu chuukug bɨtaa'n gu u'u gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bɨx gu suudai' mi'p gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu suudai' mi'p gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr maa'n gio bɨx gu takarui' gu mar gu Isaii gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oidha' u'va jix duñia' bɨx bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt.

Na bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu jodai' bhaan tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n naak na ja'p gu mar tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu mar gu Isaii tu' oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu mar tu' jix duñia' tu duukam bhaan tu' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Doeg gu suudai' ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Isaii suudai' u'va gu Nob gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu duukam gio jix maa gu kuchii gu Goliat gu Pilisteo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ gu ux jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob gu ux bɨx gu vaak gu taat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p gu Nob; gio ba' bɨx tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu takarui' jano' gu mar gu Aitob; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; na pai' dhuuk gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu jodai' bhaan tu' gu mar gu Isaii na pai' dhuuk tu' chɨɨdak gu takarui' gu kuchii gu takarui' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix búup bhaan tu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Aimelek gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' chɨkka tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu Dabii gu takarui' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu vaak.

Jano' ba' kua'da' tu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' ka't tu'; gio ba' cham jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu duukam tu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat; na gu' tu duukam matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar dhi' gu chuukug jix gɨ' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' koi gu Aimelek tu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam nukadham ka't xikoolh; gio ba' mia'n gu takarui' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gio gu novɨ bɨɨx gu Dabii pu'ñir gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jix duñia'; gu' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham jix duñia' gu noobh na ba' kooda' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Doeg; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui' bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu Doeg gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhai'x jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' gu suudai' gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu Nob kiicham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix dhaas gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob jup tɨɨt gu Abiatar gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Abiatar jix duñia' gu Dabii na ja'p gu Sauul ka't jix koi jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abiatar; gio ba' tu' bhai'x kua' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Doeg gu suudai' ka't gu chuukug maachim gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr tu' jix maa bua' bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu chuukug cham jum i'obh; na jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gio gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' dhi' gu chuukug nukadham.
Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Pilisteos jugi gu Keila gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu jiim gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam gu Pilisteos gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' gu takarui' gu Pilisteos gu jodai' gu Keila.
Gu' gu' mi'p bɨɨx gu Dabii gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' no'ch gu Judaa dhi' bɨɨx ɨɨbhi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n tu' tu'ch gu Keila bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu chuukug gu Keila tu' kapbhai' gu noobh gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Dabii bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Keila gu ux bhaan gu Pilisteos jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' naaka'n bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu Keila.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug gu Abiatar gu mar gu Aimelek gu Dabii gu Keila suudai' u'va gio bɨɨx gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't tɨbiap gu Keila; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' tu' gu jodai' gu noobh; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' kiicham bɨɨx kiki'ñgob jix kup.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sauul bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chuukug na ba' jix dhaav gu Keila gu takarui' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu Sauul jix duñia' cham bhai' bhaan gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu duukam juraa'n gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Sauul gu chuukug jix ai bhaan gu Keila cham tu' duu kiicham gu ux kuiñcha gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu takarui' gu Keila gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu Sauul na ja'p tu duukam juraa'n naak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' kapbhai' gu takarui' gu Keila tu' gu chichio'ñ gu noobh gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Te kapbhai'.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jano' ba' jix búup bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt moor gu Keila jix bɨɨx duu baasɨ'n; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu ja'tkam gu Sauul na ja'p gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook gu Keila; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't oidha' jix gaki gu oi'ñga'n jix daa gu kavɨk oidha' jix gaki gu Sip; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul bɨx gu tanoolh gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham do'ñcho gu noobh.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dabii gu Sauul ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ux oidha' jix gaki gu Sip.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu ux jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham jum i'obh cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Sauul gu taat tu' gu takarui' bhaan gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' gook mi' dhɨr tu'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Sauul gu taat gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' ba'k jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ux gu Jonataan jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sip a'ga gu Sauul gu chuukug; gio ba' cham gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam gu kutun gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu ja'tkam gu akîla gu novɨ tu jiim oidha' jix gaki.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug jano' jootom bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jugi tu'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu jodai' pai' juraa'n tɨɨt chɨkka ka't buupui; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n pai' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; na tu' gu oidha' tu' gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix búup jix bɨɨx duu gu Sip vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gu' gu Dabii gu ja'tkam mi'p oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon gu bhóogɨt kɨɨ'n oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Sauul bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gu' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jix dhaav gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Sauul jix kai chɨ'ɨɨk gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu chuukug gu ux gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Dabii bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Dabii na ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gu' gu Sauul gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu ja'tkam na ba' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va mattuda' gu Sauul bham; na gu' jix ai na gu' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ta'tak bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha jix dhaas mii' dhɨr pai' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sela-amma-lekot.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ta'tak bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha jix dhaas mii' dhɨr pai' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ jix daa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk gu Engaddi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Sauul jix duñia' gu Pilisteos jix maa aa'ñdham bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Sauul vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer gu bhóogɨt pai' ka't jumpa'n chɨbiapui gu Sauul gu ñi'ook tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n mi'p gu oi'ñga'n jumpa'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' kapbhai' bhaamki'ñdha' gu noobh jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jugii'ñ gu kutun gu Sauul.
Na gu' mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii gu jodai' na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook jugii'ñ gu takarui' gu Sauul.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu novɨ bhaan; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Sauul gamai' jumpa'n ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gio gu Dabii jix búup mi' dhɨr gamai' jumpa'n jix maa jiiñak gu oi'ñga'n gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu Sauul jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu vupui gu oidha' jix duu tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Dabii jix duñia' cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' buupui gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu noobh jumpa'n; na gu' gui'p tu' mu'aa gu' tu' gu chuukug na gu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu suudai' gu novɨ bhaan gu Jawatan na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu taat gu chuukug gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jugii'ñ gu kutun gu novɨ; na gu' tu' gu chuukug jugii'ñ gu kutun cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix maati' tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ tu' uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ cham ka't bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu jodai' gu ux; na ba' gu novɨ cham ka't bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bhaan chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel chɨkka o'bhagi'ñchu' gagai' jix koi gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jir bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p gu Dabii jix bɨɨx duu a'ga dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul; gio ba' cham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu mar gu chuukug gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jir bhai' gu chuukug tu' gu chuukug bɨɨx xoi'kam gu jodai' tu' gu chuukug bɨɨx cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu chuukug xoi'kam; na gu' cham jix koi gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' kiicha' tu' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx xoi'kam gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' na ja'p tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' gu suudai' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug jano' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Sauul gu vaak gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Samueel jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Rama; gio ba' jix búup gu Dabii ka't oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan.
Jano' ba' gu Maoon ka't gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu i'ii'ñ gu Karmelo ka't gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug ga'ra' vaik jix bhai'x kakneer jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bakia' gu suudai' kakneer gu Karmelo.

Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't gu Nabal gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Abigail; gio ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' nɨidhidha'; gu' gu chio'ñ ka't jix bhai'x tomaat gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' ka't gu ma'nkam gu Kaleb.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Nabal jix duñia' kakneer.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii mambhɨɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Karmelo gu bhóogɨt gu Nabal ñio'kdha' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi; na gu takarui' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ja'tkam vaak bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨx gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jano' bipia'dam gu jodai' jix duñia' dhi' bɨɨx no'ch cham pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu kavɨk tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi' gu Karmelo.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' dhi' ja'tkam gu suudai' nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ tu duukam gu mar gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Dabii gui'p gu Nabal bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dabii jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nabal gu suudai' gu Dabii; gio ba' chɨkka gu Dabii chɨkka gu mar gu Isaii mui'x tu duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tu' jano' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu duukam na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ cham tu' duukat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Dabii suulh gu ux gu bhóogɨt tɨɨtɨs gui'p gu Dabii bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' maa'n gu kuchii; jano' ba' gio gu Dabii jix duñia' gu kuchii; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Dabii na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ mi'x dhaas gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu suudai' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abigail gu u'vɨ gu Nabal bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Dabii bhañ gu takarui' oidha' jix gaki tulhiiñdha' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk tu' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jix maat bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' dhi' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tukaa' bɨx gu tanoolh gu jodai' dhi' bɨɨx gu chuukug kakneer.

Na gu' jano' gu chuukug gu suudai' duñia' na gu' cham bhai' bɨx gu suudai' bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' bhaan bɨx gu vaak; na gu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu bhóogɨt ñiokda'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abigail jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gook o'jo' suudai' u'va jixchamaam kakneer gu takarui' jixchamaam gu suudai' kai'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Nabal.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ñi'ook jix dhaav gu ux baasɨ'n gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu suudai' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n aajidha' jix bhai'x ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' nukadham bɨx gu ux juraa'n oidha' jix gaki cham cham tu' ka't gu suudai' bɨx gu jodai' gu kutun; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt cham bhai' gu ux xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu xibh cham no'ñ mi'x dhaas bɨx ka't gu kutun tu' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Abigail jix ñi' gu Dabii jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Dabii bhaan gu vupui jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' mi'x juu'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu chuukug bhaan tu' ka't uañi'ñ; gu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios maatɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' jano' gu Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Nabal; na gu' jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr mɨmɨim gu Nabal gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx; gu' tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham tu' gu suudai' gu Jawatan tu' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu chuukug gu ux gu suudai' gu novɨ; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu Nabal obhɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' cham bhai' bhaan gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' dhi' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan tu' gu jodai' gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios dhi' uañi'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨda' jix duñia' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan na gu' gu Jawatan duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios cham bhai' cham tu' gaagam tu' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' xoi'kam jix bhai'x ka't jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu oidha' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan ka't gu jodai' gu vupui gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ obhɨɨ'ñ na ja'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu Jawatan jurtu'nka' bɨx xoi'kam tu' tu ñi'ook tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu chuukug cham tu' ka't dhi' gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch vaak na jix bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr cham kuiñcha gu Jawatan ka't gu chuukug gu ux; na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu Jawatan na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu takarui' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abigail; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' bhañ na ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka't gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu takarui' gu ux gu suudai' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu jodai' gu chuukug cham bhai' tu' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt jix maa gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xibh cham gu suudai' gu Nabal gu jodai' gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu novɨ ka't gu jodai'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' naak gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Abigail suudai' u'va gu Nabal gu suudai' ga'ra' gu takarui' gu vaak na ja'p gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Nabal ka't jix bhai'x ka't gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ux cham gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu' jix jai' bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va gu tanoolh buimgidhak.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va ka't gu ñi'ook gu Nabal jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu suudai' tu'x; gio ba' xoi'kam gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' na ja'p gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu Nabal jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix kai gu Nabal ka't jix koi; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' kuiñcha gu ja'tkam gu duukam gu novɨ gu Nabal tu' gu suudai' cham bhai' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu Nabal bhaan gu suudai' mo'o; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Dabii ñiokda' gu Abigail na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Dabii tɨɨtɨs gu Abigail gu Karmelo tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bham; gio ba' gu Dabii tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' jix búup jix duñia' gu vupui gu oidha' bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na ba' ka't gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tɨɨt tu duukam gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Abigail bɨɨx jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñchu' gɨ' kavɨk gu ñi'ook chɨ'ɨɨk gu takarui' gu Dabii ka't gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gio jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu Ainoam gu Jesreel gu ñi'ook gook jix bɨɨx duu gu u'vɨ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Sauul ka't jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl gu u'vɨ gu Dabii gu Palti gu mar gu Lais ka't gu Gallim.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Sipeos gu Sauul gu chuukug bham; gio ba' cham gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam gu ja'tkam gu akîla vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jano' ba' jix búup jix dhaav oidha' jix gaki gu Sip gu suudai' baidhak vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Sip.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sauul yooxi' gu ja'tkam gu akîla vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' gu Sauul gu takarui' pai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu ux gu jodai' bhañ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux tɨɨda' gu Sauul ka't tɨbiap.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook pai' gu Sauul ka't gu bhóogɨt yooxi'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii pai' jix koox gu Sauul gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Sauul kookos gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ux yooxi' gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Aimelek gu takarui' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia xibhɨk gu Joab bham; gio ba' chɨkka jix dhaav gu chuukug gu Sauul yooxi' jix aa' gu Abisai; mi' dhɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨndak.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Abisai tɨɨtɨs gu ja'tkam gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Sauul ka't gu chuukug kookos gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu oidha' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu Abner gu ja'tkam mi'p xikoolh gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abisai gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios dhagia' bhaamki'ñdha' gu noobh; mi' dhɨr jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' bɨɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Abisai; gio ba' cham gu jodai'; na gu' chɨkka jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tasi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chuukug gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu jodai' jix dhaav gu chuukug gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jano' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu vaak gu Sauul jix bɨɨx duu; na cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak gu chuukug tu' gu chuukug tu' gu jodai' bɨx gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix dhaam suudai' koox gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu vaak bhaan.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Dabii baasɨ'n jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu kavɨk dhaibu jix gɨ' jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix maa jiiñak gu Dabii gu ja'tkam gu Abner gu mar gu Ner bham; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu Abner jano' ba' gu Abner jix aa'; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu chuukug tu' gu chuukug jiiñak gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abner; gio ba' cham gu chuukug gu chio'ñ tu' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' gu Israeel gu ux gu ñi'ook cham nukadham gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan tu' kia'mi'ñ maa'n gu ja'tkam kooda' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook cham xoi'kam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' koi'm cham jix duñia' nukadham gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' jano' duukat gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' ka't gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu takarui' gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' cham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu chuukug gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Jawatan tu duukam gu ñi'ook cham bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' soi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar; gu' tu' ka't gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' baas gu ñi'ook na ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios bham; jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' jano' gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu kutun na ja'p gu chuukug gu suudai' gu ux gu kakkavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu chuukug gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui; jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x maa'n gu suudai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' maa'n bɨx bhai' jix duñia'; na gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't dhagia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ja'p gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui ka't gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios namkidhat bɨx gu jodai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug tu' gu mar gu chuukug gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chuukug gu takarui'; jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul jix duñia' pai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix koi gu kutun gu tanoolh gu ux gu novɨ gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu ux gu jodai' ka't tutkɨ gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Pilisteos na ba' gu Sauul mi'x dhaas tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu suudai' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ ga'ra' baidhak gu ñi'ook gu Akîs gu mar gu Maok gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Dabii bɨɨx gu Akîs gu Gat gu oi'ñga'n maa'n bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Dabii bɨɨx gook gu u'vɨ gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu ja'tkam gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu Gat cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Akîs; gio ba' tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui ka't jix maa pai' gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' pai' jix duñia'; na gu' tu' jix koi tu duukam bɨndak kiicham vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Akîs jix maa mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Siklag; gio ba' ka't gu Siklag gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh gu Dabii jix daa gu oidha' gu Pilisteos maakobh masaa'n dhɨt gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Dabii bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bhaan ba'k gu Gesureos gu Gerseos gu Amalekitas; na gu' dhi' ja'tkam oi'ñka' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' dɨr na ja'p tu' gu Sur bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n cham mi'x dhaas gu oidha' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' kakneer gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix ai gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Akîs.
Jano' ba' chɨtda gu takarui'; gio ba' duukat jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii chɨtda; mi' dhɨr saagi'ñ gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Jerameel bhaan saagi'ñ gu Keni.

Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ mi'x dhaas gu oidha' gu Dabii gu suudai' gu Gat; gio ba' bham; na gu' cham jix maa aa'ñdham no'ch bham dhi' jix duu gu Dabii; jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu takarui' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix koi gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Akîs gu suudai' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu ux jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Israeel ka't bɨɨx tas tu duukam.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ vaak ja'tkam na ba' gu ux bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix aa' gu Akîs gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar tɨɨda' jix buus gu chuukug vaak ja'tkam tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Akîs; gio ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Akîs jix aa' gu Dabii; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu bhóogɨt jix nukadham mo'o bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Samueel ka't jix koi bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu takarui' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Rama kiicham; gio ba' gu Sauul ka't baas gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Na gu' na ja'p gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ tɨɨtɨs jix duñia' yooxi' gu Sunam; gio ba' gu Sauul jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' yooxi' gu Gilboa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' gu Sauul yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix aa' tu' gu ux tɨɨtki' tu' gu ux gu Urim tu' gu ux jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu suudai'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu suudai' cham tu'x jai'ch gu u'vɨ gu Endor juraa'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sauul jix dhaas jajannulhi'ñ ka't bɨɨx gook gu chichio'ñ tɨɨtɨs mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' ñɨidhat gu Sauul tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu jodai' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oidha' na ba' gu takarui' kooda'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' tu' ɨlhdham gu ux dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu bhóogɨt gu kutun jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu kutun gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu u'vɨ gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Sauul bham.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu chuukug gu Sauul; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook buupui gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' buupui gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x jupaabkamu'n jix bhaan dhaas gu kutun; jano' ba' gu Sauul jano' ba' jix duñia' ka't gu Samueel gu suudai' gu vupui gu oidha' jix duu tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chuukug gu kutun gu Sauul jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug; na gu' gu Pilisteos gu takarui' bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu vaak tu' cham tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' gu ux tɨɨtki'; gio ba' gu ux dhi' tu' tɨɨgim na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook no'ñ bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaamki'ñdha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ tu' jix maa duiñchu' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ i'iich gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Amalek gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu Israeel gio bɨndak gu noobh gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu xibh ka't gu chuukug tu' gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' yooxi' gu Israeel kapbhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Sauul gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' ka't jix duñia' choo'n gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Samueel; na gu' cham jix duñia' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' cham ka't jugi gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va gu Sauul jimchu' jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu novɨ naak gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' gio gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' vupui bhaan tu' gu chin gu takarui' jugi na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham jugi; gu' gu suudai' bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu jodai' jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix búup gu takarui' jix daa bhaan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ ga'ra' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tasi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham jabka'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ vupui bhaan gu Sauul gu suudai'; gio ba' a'lhiok jugi jix búup jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ bɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Apek; gio ba' gu Israeel jix dhaas yooxi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n chiñia' gu Pilisteos jugi chamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu Akîs.

Jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam dhi' ja'tkam gu ebreos gu Akîs jix aa' chiñia' gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr cham gu ux gu Dabii tu duukam gu Sauul gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' dhi' gu chuukug dhɨt gu tanoolh dhɨt gu takarui' cham gaagam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' bhaan gui'p; gio ba' gu jodai' dhi' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' pai' nɨi'ñchudat cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx no'ch gu chuukug cham ka't gu chuukug jix duñia' bhaamki'ñdha'; na gu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt tutkɨ nɨidhidha' gu Jawatan bɨɨx ɨɨbhidham dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham dhi' gu Dabii alabaa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' gu Sauul naaka'n gu ja'tkam gu Dabii mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs jup tɨɨt gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu ñi'ook ba'k yooxi' gu chuukug matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gaagam tu' dɨr gu tanoolh gu jodai' tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gu' gu vupui chiñia' cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui chiñia' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gaagam tu duukam dɨr gu tanoolh dhi' bɨndak bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug jix bhai' gu vupui na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gu' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx no'ch gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu xibh tu' tu duukam gu Jawatan jix duñia' tɨbiap bɨndak; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu xibh gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii gu xibh gu oi'ñga'n na ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu gu Jesreel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨtɨs gu Siklag vaik gu tanoolh gu Amalek gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ saagi'ñ gu Siklag gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu Siklag gu bhóogɨt gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' baabuk gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ mi'p dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'; gu' soo'mchulhdhak gu suudai' jix koi gu ñi'ook baabuk gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n kiicham gu suudai' ka't vaak na jix bhaan gu tai gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix xuaak.
Jano' ba' gook gu u'vɨ gu Dabii gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo gio jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu Dabii ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' na gu' gu ja'tkam ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug; na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ux ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gu' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Abiatar gu mar gu Aimelek; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Abiatar gu ñi'ook gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook cham uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx mi'p tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu Besor pai' gu ñi'ook dhɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii chɨ'ɨɨk gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ; na gu' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu chio'ñ gu Egipkio aichdhak gu Dabii jix maa gu takarui' jugi i'i gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gio gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix jugi jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; na gu' cham ka't jugi gu takarui' tu' gu takarui' gu suudai' vaik gu tanoolh vaik gu tukaa'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' chɨkka gu chuukug tu' duukat gu chuukug jix aa' gu takarui' gu Egipkio; na gu' tu' jix duñia' tu duukam gu Amalekita gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' vaik gu tanoolh na gu' ka't ka'ook.
Na gu' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n baasɨ'n saagi'ñ gu Kereti gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Kaleb; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tai gu Siklag.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu jodai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios cham koo'nda' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh gu takarui' tu' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu suudai' mi'p gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jugi i'i gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ux bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos pai' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Dabii dɨr mii' dhɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai gu tanoolh buimgidhak; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n biipibop gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ jix ai jiboi'ññor.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii bɨx gu Amalekitas gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Dabii gook gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jix gɨ' gu ma'nkam na ja'p ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ux bɨx tu'x gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' bɨx jix duñia' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Dabii bɨx kakneer gu vaakax gu duukam; gio ba' gu takarui' bɨx vupui bhaan am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ jix daa jix duñia' gu jodai' cham jix daa gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu Dabii jix daa gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhi'ñbak gu Besor; gio ba' moor gu takarui' gu Dabii gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tulhiiñdha' bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx tomaat gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Dabii tu ñi'ook gui'p; na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx no'ch cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook maa'n gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' cham xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu suudai' tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' nukadham tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ suudai' u'va bhaan no'ch.
Na gu' chɨkka jix duñia' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' gu jodai' baasɨ'n tu' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu jodai'; na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' ka't dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux ñi'ook na tu a'ga jir bɨx bhai' gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Siklag bhañ gu ja'tkam daraa gu Judaa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Bet-el gu Ramot saagi'ñ mi'p gu Jattir.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Aroer gu Sipmot mi'p gu Estemoa.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Rakâl mi'p jɨ'dɨlh gu Jerameel mi'p jɨ'dɨlh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu orma mi'p gu jodai' mi'p gu Atak.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu ebroon bɨx pai' gu Dabii ka't dhi' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos gu ux bɨɨx gu Israeel jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos ia'rɨ koko'kam gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos gu Sauul gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu Jonataan gu Abinadab gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug bhaan gu Sauul jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' choo'n gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu jodai' bɨɨx na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug; na gu' gu' kutun kavɨk cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' ga'ra' choo'n; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Sauul gu kuchii mi'x juu'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ kutun kavɨk gu Sauul jix koi gio mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu kuchii jix koi bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨma'n bɨɨx vaik gu ma'nkam kutun kavɨk bɨx gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Jordaan ñɨi'ñ gu Israeel ka't jix duñia' gu Sauul gu ma'nkam jix duñia' koko'kam gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jiboi'ññor; gio ba' gu Pilisteos tɨɨtɨs jix daa.
Jano' ba' ka't buimgidhak gu tanoolh bai'ñpu' gu Pilisteos gu takarui' koko'kam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul vaik gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mo'o cham kutun gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mɨjɨ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan duiñxim gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Astarot jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Bet-san.
Gu' gu' tɨiñ gu Jabes gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu Pilisteos jix duu gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix búup jix duñia' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Sauul gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Bet-san; gio ba' bai'ñpu' gu Jabes gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk o'oo gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu u'u gu Jabes jix duñia' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
